_comment: Card combinations surfaced in the deck builder. Each pair is a real mechanical interaction implemented in card_effects.gd / enemy.gd.

combos.text: Curved runners take +50% fire damage from Heat Wave and burns.
Twin Play adds one more target to Grand Relay.
Twin Play adds one more lightning bounce.

Pull a crowd together, then rain fire on it.

Gather runners, then slam them all with Power Catch.
Rooted runners can't walk out of the fire.
Runners pile up behind the wall — a perfect barrage target.
Frozen runners can't dodge the barrage.
Dragged-back runners cross your traps again.
Confused runners run back over the trap.

Soften a runner with Power Throw, then pick it off.
Refill energy to afford your most expensive card.
